يتقاضوا (form VI)
# يَتَقَاضَوْا (yataqāḍaw) /ja.ta.qaː.dˤaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# يُتَقَاضَوْا (yutaqāḍaw) /ju.ta.qaː.dˤaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
